name: attendance_letter_2
subject: Attendance - second letter - {pupil_name}
body: We wrote to you earlier about {first_name}'s attendance. Unfortunately it remains a concern.
{first_name}'s attendance from {period} is {attendance_pct}%. {first_name} has missed {sessions_missed} sessions (half-days), {unauthorised} of them unauthorised.

If attendance does not improve, the school may need to involve formal support, which can include a parenting contract or a referral to the local authority. We would much rather work with you to avoid this - please contact us.

placeholders.pupil_name: The pupil's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.details: Meeting date, the agreed target and any extra note
